## Checklist

Check every box. Reviewers verify these and close PRs that fail them.

- [ ] The branch is rebased on the latest `dev`.
- [ ] Every commit follows Conventional Commits (one logical change each, no `wip` commits).
- [ ] The diff contains no commented-out code, no debug prints, no unrelated formatting changes.
- [ ] This PR resolves exactly one issue.
